terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A glossy collectible power-up charm: a plump upright teardrop of swirled rainbow paint (violet, red, blue, yellow, mint bands) with a polished gold ring around its middle, four small coloured four-point star petals around the ring, and a tiny glowing warm bead on its tip. Photograph of a real glossy designer vinyl art-toy collectible, smooth sculpted soft-vinyl and lacquered resin surfaces, saturated candy paint colours with real paint drips, crisp studio product lighting, high detail. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.
